notes.title: Purple Eye released on One Drive, Steam release indefinitely postponed
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, sorry for not making this announcement earlier, because of issues related to mature content Steam refused yet again to allow Purple Eye an early access release.

As such, I decided to postpone the Steam release for an undetermined period of time, and to instead share it in a more "simple" way, with a One Drive link.

[url=https://1drv.ms/u/s!ApXgOyPTRjcohah1icbYMefQ5KSsJA?e=crVM4L]https://1drv.ms/u/s!ApXgOyPTRjcohah1icbYMefQ5KSsJA?e=crVM4L[/url]

Please know that this downloadable archive weighs 4GB, while the uncompressed folder is 11 GB. In addition, keep in mind that the current game is obviously unfinished and unpolished, and at times feels a bit like what we call in French a "nanar", basically a game so bad and weird it's good ! Also, it is quite demanding, you'll need a good pc to run it with correct settings, however a "Fast" quality option can really help make a difference at the obvious cost of graphic quality.

If you want to follow the progress of this project, here are the [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UC50P_6TSwYyF-altXuva9Ug]YouTube channel[/url] and the [url=https://discord.gg/b3gENZ9x9e]Discord server[/url] Discord server ! You can also support me on [url=https://ko-fi.com/cheopioupiou]Ko-Fi[/url], any donation will be much appreciated.

Thanks for your understanding, and for those of you who will take the time to download and try the game, I hope you'll enjoy it despite its flaws, and don't hesitate to share what you thought of it !

Cheo

notes.title: Release delated to late August
notes.notes:
Hello, I'm sorry to announce that Purple Eye's release has once more been delayed - it was initially supposed to be released tomorrow, but the build verification was once again a failure, partly because of a folder mistake from my part and because of mature content. As gradually adding new type of mature content may be an issue, I will create a new scene that will contain ALL type of mature content the final game is meant to contain, including things like torture and rape, so that Steam will acknowledge and agree to the presence of each.

I requested that the release date be delayed to the 30th of August to be safe. Please accept my apologies, I'll make sure that this is the very last delay and that the first release will not disappoint ! Cheo
